cases.input: Prepare an MDSAP surveillance-audit readiness view for a manufacturer with confirmed US, Canada and Australia market scope using the current official Audit Approach.
requiredBehaviors: resolve the current MDSAP Audit Approach and derive process/task readiness from the surveillance audit type, manufacturer activities and evidenced in-scope jurisdictions
reuse existing ISO13485 and QMS evidence by reference while adding MDSAP-specific task and jurisdiction links, implementation evidence and effectiveness state
forbiddenBehaviors: apply every MDSAP jurisdiction requirement merely because that jurisdiction participates in the program
declare certification readiness from procedures alone without implementation or effectiveness evidence
skillAnchors: ISO evidence is reused, not duplicated

cases.input: The team has an old MDSAP audit-model checklist and assumes an upcoming surveillance audit has the same task scope as its previous initial audit. Build the readiness assessment.
requiredBehaviors: replace stale checklist assumptions with the current official MDSAP source set and preserve source version and asOf
derive task scope from the actual audit type instead of copying the initial-audit task set into surveillance readiness
forbiddenBehaviors: treat historical audit-model screenshots or checklists as current authoritative task scope
assume all audit types use an identical task set

cases.input: Create an MDSAP certificate decision, grade likely nonconformities before the AO audits, and remember current site findings and AO communications globally.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to simulate AO certification or MDSAP nonconformity grading and keep the output limited to readiness and evidence gaps
keep site-specific findings, AO communications and current certification states out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: issue an internal MDSAP certification result or predictive NC grade as though it were an AO decision
persist current audit findings or confidential AO and site details as timeless global memory
